item.title: 面向跨域材料机器学习的潜在表征域对齐审计
item.description:
📚 Machine Learning: Science and Technology
👤 Henry R N B Enninful
该研究审计了跨域材料机器学习中潜在表征是否真正捕捉可迁移的结构—性质关系，还是主要编码域特异性偏差。作者以实验多孔碳、实验金属有机框架以及模拟金属有机框架数据为对象，训练带缺失掩码的无目标神经编码器，并通过域对抗与噪声一致性目标考察潜在空间几何变化。结果显示，对齐仅是部分实现：跨域邻域混合增强、整体域可分性降低，但局部域结构仍然保留，且更好的潜在空间几何并未必然带来更好的跨域预测性能。

item.title: Nonadiabatic excited-state dynamics with quantum Monte Carlo-trained machine learning: azomethane as a stringent test
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Alfonso Annarelli, Emiel Slootman, Claudia Filippi
arXiv:2607.16129v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We introduce quantum Monte Carlo (QMC)-trained multi-state machine-learned (ML) force fields for nonadiabatic excited-state dynamics, targeting photochemical processes in which the electronic character changes along the reaction path and a consistent correlated description is required. In this framework, variational Monte Carlo wave functions combine compact selected configuration-interaction expansions with a Jastrow factor that explicitly accounts for dynamical correlation, while neural networks convert the stochastic QMC data into smooth potential energy surfaces for large surface-hopping ensembles. We apply this approach to azomethane, a demanding test case involving torsional relaxation through conical-intersection regions and C--N bond…

arXiv:2505.19909v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Neural Network-based Quantum Monte Carlo (NNQMC), an emerging method for solving many-body quantum systems with high accuracy, has been mainly applied to small systems due to demanding computation requirements. arXiv:2512.03829v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Reliable operation of high-power proton cyclotrons is a critical requirement for Accelerator Driven Systems (ADS) and other large-scale applications. item.title: A Bit of Freedom Goes a Long Way: Classical and Quantum Algorithms for Reinforcement Learning under a Generative Model
item.description:

arXiv:2507.22854v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We propose novel classical and quantum online algorithms for learning finite- and infinite-horizon Markov Decision Processes (MDPs). item.title: 铈氢化物性质的化学计量比依赖性：基于主动学习构建原子间势的研究
item.description:
📚 Phys. Rev. Materials
👤 Brenden W. Hamilton, Travis E. Jones, Timothy C. Germann, and Benjamin T. Nebgen
该研究针对铈氢化物随氢含量变化而出现的晶格收缩、致密化及相关性质展开计算研究。由于实验中精确控制化学计量比较困难，而第一性原理方法难以覆盖大规模性质计算，作者采用主动学习开发的原子间势来研究不同组成下的材料行为。该工作旨在为铈氢化物的组成—结构—性质关系提供更高效的模拟工具。

Such equations are challenging for standard PINN methods because they involve nonlinearities, nonlocal interaction terms, and an underlying gradient-flow structure, often leading to slow convergence and difficult optimization. We adapt the PINN methodology to DDFT gradient-flow equations and introduce two computational components: a modified Lorentzian activation function that behaves approximately linearly for small inputs and decays toward zero as the input magnitude increases, and a precomputed discrete operator for evaluating the nonlocal convolution term efficiently during train…

We propose a closed-loop evolutionary algorithm that guides an LLM to generate complete, executable PINN configurations across generations, using measured training outcomes to determine subsequent search decisions. item.title: 界面工程实现交替磁性 CrSb 多铁隧道结中的巨多态电阻开关
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zhi Yan, Yuwen Hua, Yueting Li, Xujin Zhang, Jianhua Xiao, Xiaohong Xu
该研究结合密度泛函理论和非平衡格林函数方法，提出 CrSb/α-In2Se3 交替磁性多铁隧道结可实现巨大的多态电阻开关。结果表明，器件响应不仅由 CrSb 体相自旋劈裂决定，更受界面对称性选择机制控制：Cr/Sb 端接以及 h-BN 或石墨烯插层决定自旋通道匹配，而铁电极化调控静电势垒。单层 In2Se3 结可呈现四个非易失电阻态，隧穿磁阻和隧穿电阻效应分别可达到 1626% 和 2206%，显示出界面工程在交替磁自旋电子器件中的重要作用。

item.title: 交替磁性纳米线中的一阶拓扑 FFLO 转变与超导二极管符号反转
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Bo Fu, Kaizhi Bai, Chang-An Li, Shun-Qing Shen
该研究表明，与 d 波交替磁体近邻耦合的自旋轨道耦合纳米线可在无净磁化条件下实现拓扑 FFLO 态，并且该态通过一阶相变出现。交替磁场诱导能带分辨的竞争配对通道，形成双谷自由能景观，使全局能量极小值发生不连续切换，并伴随 Cooper 配对振幅和有限质心动量的突变。该不连续拓扑重构显著增强超导二极管效率，并在相变处产生尖锐的符号反转，为拓扑 FFLO 态提供了直接输运指纹。

item.title: 通过非互易耗散过程控制电荷流与自旋流
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Catalin-Mihai Halati, Jean-Sébastien Bernier
该研究在破缺反演和时间反演对称性的二维有自旋费米原子量子系统中，探讨通过非互易耗散机制产生和控制电荷流与自旋流。作者在 Gorini–Kossakowski–Sudarshan–Lindblad 主方程框架下，结合含时广义 Gibbs 系综方法，确定了弱耗散耦合下诱导并调控电荷流和自旋流所需的最小非互易跃迁算符集合。在存在有限隧穿、Rashba 耦合和磁场时，两个分别将不同自旋分量非互易耦合到不同运动方向的跃迁算符即可产生两类电流；调节非互易程度可使主导输运机制在自旋流和电荷流之间转变，并且该机制对退相干噪声具有鲁棒性。

item.title: 无长程有序的交替磁性
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 V. E. Valiulin, A. V. Mikheyenkov, K. I. Kugel
该文基于Kugel–Khomskii自旋—赝自旋模型，从理论上研究在没有长程磁有序或轨道有序时交替磁性行为的出现。利用旋转不变Green函数方法，作者分析了二维方格和一维链中的关联函数、激发谱、热容与磁化率。结果显示，当子系统间交换超过临界值时，可形成具有非零自旋—赝自旋关联的复合态，尽管局域平均自旋和赝自旋均为零；激发谱分裂及节点线特征体现了交替磁对称性。

item.title: 磁性 Hopfion 的可逆与不可逆动力学拓扑转变
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 S. Y. Lu, H. M. Dong, D. X. Yu, K. Chang
磁性 Hopfion 是具有非零 Hopf 不变量的三维拓扑孤子，是三维自旋电子学的潜在平台。该研究通过三维微磁模拟和解析模分析，揭示交变磁场可驱动受限 Hopfion 出现两类不同动力学行为：弱场下，本征模共振激发导致非线性不稳定，并使 Hopfion 不可逆地重构为 toron；强场下，体系以 GHz 频率在拓扑平庸铁磁态与 Hopfion 态之间发生可逆场锁定切换。切换路径由驱动频率选择，例如 2 GHz 对应呼吸型路径，而 40 GHz 产生非共振旋转路径。

item.title: 反铁磁Kuramoto晶格中的锯齿有序、缺陷与反常弛豫
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Priyanka D. Bhoyar, Prashant M. Gade
该研究考察了具有负最近邻耦合的Kuramoto振子在非平衡条件下的有序动力学，该耦合诱导锯齿状反铁磁有序。在一维系统中，缺陷密度呈现反常缓慢粗化，按约t⁻¹/⁴衰减，并在与系统尺寸相关的时间尺度后饱和；局域持续概率呈拉伸指数形式且指数同样为1/4。结果表明，即便没有淬火无序或随机噪声，确定性非线性动力学与几何挫 frustration也足以产生慢弛豫和异常标度，连续介质近似和线性稳定性分析为这些现象提供了解释。

To address this, both saturation-based and hysteresis-based modeling approaches are formulated and parameterized from experimentally obtained DC hysteresis loops. item.title: SLAC: Safe and Efficient Real-Robot Reinforcement Learning via Unsupervised Simulation Pre-Training
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Jiaheng Hu, Peter Stone, Roberto Martín-Martín
arXiv:2506.04147v5 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Building capable household and industrial robots requires mastering the control of versatile, high-degree-of-freedom (DoF) systems such as mobile manipulators. While reinforcement learning (RL) holds promise for autonomously acquiring robot control policies, scaling it to high-DoF embodiments remains challenging. Direct RL in the real world demands both safe exploration and high sample efficiency, which are difficult to achieve in practice. Sim-to-real RL, on the other hand, is often brittle due to the reality gap. This paper introduces SLAC, a method that renders real-world RL feasible for complex embodiments by leveraging a low-fidelity simulator to pretrain a task-agnostic latent action space. arXiv:2511.05002v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Although BCS wave functions for superconductors under periodic boundary conditions are well established, obtaining an explicit form of the many-body BCS wave function under open boundary condition is usually a nontrivial problem.
